svg.title: निदान बोर्ड — the diagnosis board
svg.desc: दादाजी's cork board from the bank: wooden frame, four brass corners, a faded notice strip at the top. Twenty fixed slots round one centre card; a card never changes slot. Red wool (लाल ऊन) runs from each card's pin to the centre card. The centre card is covered by a slip with a question mark until scene 2.8, then reads मिथ्यादर्शन. दादाजी's own card sits face down, without a thread, in the bottom screen-left corner until he takes it down for scene 6.8. Titles are the ones written in the screenplay. States left to right: ch1 (6 cards, 6 threads), ch2 (10, 10), ch3 (12, 12; unchanged through chapter 4), ch5 (12, plus three small map tags and सम's slip above the centre), ch6 (as scene 6.8 finds it: the corner slot empty), ch7 (after 7.1A: अर्जुन's card turned over and re-pinned, दादाजी's card back, face up), final (after 7.5: दादी's card ११ beside his, tied with the last of her wool). Anatomy of a single card: nidan-card.svg.
